mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT SCVB.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B SCB, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B SCVB WHERE SCB.CODE = 'CSH301_WRITE_OFF_TYPE' AND SCB.CODE_ID = SCVB.CODE_ID AND SCVB.VALUE = 'ADVANCE_REFUND') AS WRITE_OFF_TYPE_N, LINE.REFUND_AMOUNT - nvl((SELECT SUM(SLN.PAY_AMOUNT) FROM CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_SLIP_LN SLN WHERE LINE.REFUND_LINE_ID = SLN.DOCUMENT_ID AND SLN.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'CSH_TRANSACTION_REFUND_LINE' and exists(select 1 from CSH_PAYMENT_REQ_SLIP sl where sl.SLIP_ID = SLN.SLIP_ID and sl.SLIP_STATUS in ('PAID', 'DETAIL_ERROR', 'DETAIL_SEND') ) ), 0) AS WRITE_OFF_DUE_AMOUNT, REFUND.REFUND_NUM AS CONTRACT_NUMBER, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = CT.BP_ID) AS TENANT_NAME FROM CSH_TRANSACTION CT, CSH_TRANSACTION_REFUND_LINE LINE, CSH_TRANSACTION_REFUND REFUND WHERE CT.TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId} AND CT.TRANSACTION_ID = LINE.SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID AND LINE.REFUND_ID = REFUND.REFUND_ID AND REFUND.REFUND_STATUS IN ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED') AND (line.PAY_STATUS != 'BACK' OR line.PAY_STATUS IS NULL)
